notes.title: v0.5.2 - Restaurant Expansion, Playstyle Update, & Employee Control Update
notes.content: [p]Hello, Chefs! 🧑🏻‍🍳🦞[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for all your support and feedback during Early Access! We've been listening closely and working on small but meaningful improvements to enhance your restaurant management experience.[/p][p]Here are some of the key points we heard from you:[/p][list][*][p]More space is needed to grow the restaurant and serve a larger number of customers.[/p][/*][*][p]Prep cooks sometimes keep working past their scheduled hours, so there should be a clearer way to set their shift limits.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes, players just want to run the kitchen themselves without being interrupted or slowed down by staff behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p]Based on that, we’ve added new features and refinements that give you more flexibility, control, and breathing room as your seaside kitchen continues to grow.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Restaurant Expansion[/b][/h3][p]You can now expand your restaurant to accommodate more guests and grow your business. This expansion includes a larger kitchen, cold storage, staff room, and additional dining areas on both the first floor and the newly accessible second floor. Click the door next to the restroom to unlock the expansion once you reach level 20 and have at least $40,000 in funds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/f05095a2658d0c2c256cfc454a485e261d7a8b98.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/8853660c30f60229ae53bbfee915cf8ff0e5aa41.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/47e8e86182dfb0be167f394d2977726786b52e55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/01781398fe1b2609f6abbf28e1f5b19573d1c1f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Prep Cook Work Hour Settings[/b][/h3][p]You can now set specific working hours for your prep cooks. This gives you greater control over your kitchen operations, allowing you to decide when they should stop prepping ingredients for the day.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/10595a36edbf88044e48f39695b548ac5d4ecd9c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. Employee Control Update[/b][/h3][p]Managing employees just got easier. You can right-click any employee to send them on a break, then they’ll head to the area behind the cashier to rest. When you're ready to have them back, just right-click again to bring them back to work.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/50f4035a8f7e0bc7252cc234fa38dbec998ac9b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/27df02b5475f6fd3c2fdc003f442b0dbc203f386.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope these changes help make managing your kitchen smoother and more fun. As part of our commitment during Early Access, we always open to all feedbacks to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share them in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3444630/discussions/"]Discussions[/url] section. 😃[/p][p][/p][p]And, if you’re enjoying the game, we’d love to hear your thoughts in a Steam review! It really helps us grow and improve the experience for all.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community. [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamhappy"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers! 🧑🏻‍🍳[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630/Coastal_Kitchen_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.4.4 - Employee Status & Utensil Activation
notes.content: [p]Hello, Chefs! 🧑🏻‍🍳🦞[/p][p][/p][p]We’re back with a fresh update that gives you more control over how you run your seaside restaurant in Coastal Kitchen Simulator. Thanks to your continued feedback, we’ve rolled out several updates aimed at improving your overall experience and making restaurant management feel smoother and more enjoyable.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s dive into what’s new in this update:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Employee Status[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added new status texts to help you better understand what your employees are doing, like “otw taking food”, “otw taking dirty plates”, "cleaning dirty plates", "resting", etc. This employee status helps you manage the kitchen more efficiently without second-guessing their behavior. [/p][p]We’ve also improved their cleaning tasks, as employees can now wash scattered tray piles to keep the kitchen area tidier and running more smoothly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/fbec251535f52e9d5ea9d8065e110e92fa56d362.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/b873d87102f633b4d41770438ff7d59289e6c70e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/a4c1a81b55e58596b895b25668ca7f03fbecd81d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/1e859c70e1ce8738c88b82e16c8eb9bb4d74d53d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Utensil Activation Update[/b][/h3][p]You can now activate kitchen utensils more intuitively by clicking directly on them. We've also refined the warning messages to make it clearer when a utensil needs to be activated, helping you avoid unnecessary confusion. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/92db65052d25cfea4551164c22242fa822a5f7c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/e40fa82bdaf84c872bf6f2662392d220939966e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/3ad847532b097d1acd29f60398f4bfdaaf6d8799.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue where multiple employees couldn’t take orders at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “idle” status showing incorrectly during employee rest and shortened the rest duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed employees getting stuck inside customer tables or when trying to clean already-empty tables.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As part of our commitment during Early Access, we always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. 🦐🥘[/p][p][/p][p]And, if you’re enjoying the game, we’d love to hear your thoughts in a Steam review! It really helps us grow and improve the experience for all.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community. [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamhappy"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers! 🧑🏻‍🍳[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630/Coastal_Kitchen_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.3.2 - Beverages and Some UX Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello, Chefs! 🧑🏻‍🍳🦞[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a month since Coastal Kitchen Simulator launched in Early Access, and we’re committed to making it better with every update. Today’s patch reflects that mission, bringing meaningful features and improvements inspired by your feedback while staying true to our vision of a cozy yet challenging kitchen management experience 😀[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s dive into what’s new in this update:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Introducing Beverages[/b][/h3][p]Your customers now want more than just food. They expect drinks too! Each order will now include a beverage, adding an extra layer of challenge to your workflow. To make this easier, we’ve added a Beverages Menu on your in-game PC so you can manage drink options with ease and keep every customer satisfied.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/f623371a871d7e320a05ea0448ffdbca509c7170.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/225f2432c6492486711f4b8a0bbe3e9746b5b0be.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/e72f59fe52d61786ffbd5f4d741577013625de64.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/59e58c87b900a52899bdebf13495168cc24ff78a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/edfa0e9e8b526b84148786f54e19a6de64c9f479.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Cart Item Counter[/b][/h3][p]Tracking your purchases just got easier. A new [b]item counter[/b] is now displayed in your cart for both Ingredients and Beverages menus. This is an early version of the feature and will be further refined in upcoming updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/836f8ff1e6a6eda3e91006766037d3dd84fd83ea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Display Setting Update[/b][/h3][p]We’ve resolved an issue where the game would always open in fullscreen mode. Now your chosen display settings, including windowed or fullscreen, will be remembered every time you play.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]As part of our commitment during Early Access, we always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. 🦐🥘[/p][p][/p][p]And, if you’re enjoying the game, we’d love to hear your thoughts in a Steam review! It really helps us grow and improve the experience for all.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community. [img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamhappy"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers! 🧑🏻‍🍳[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630/Coastal_Kitchen_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.2.28 - Playstyle Setup
notes.content: [p]Hi, chefs! 🧑🏻‍🍳🦞[/p][p][/p][p]We’re back with a fresh update that gives you more control over how you run your seaside restaurant in Coastal Kitchen Simulator. Thanks to your ongoing feedback, we’ve introduced the [b]Playstyle Setup[/b] feature, allowing you to fine-tune key aspects of gameplay to suit your pace and preferences.[/p][p][/p][p]You can now adjust:[/p][list][*][p][b]Day Speed[/b] – Set how quickly time progresses during the day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-Prep Limit[/b] – Controls how many containers of each ingredient your prep cook will prepare.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customer Order Wait Time[/b] – Decide how patient your customers will be when waiting for food.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/ba5a4c18420d0d88e7932a3e3a75b4ecea608b9e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This new system lets you shape your experience into something more relaxing or more challenging, depending on your preferred kitchen rhythm. Whether you're in it for chill cooking sessions or high-pressure multitasking, the game now adapts better to your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue updating Coastal Kitchen Simulator regularly to deliver a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, if you enjoy the game we’d be grateful if you leaving a review, and don’t hesitate to leave your thoughts or suggestions in the Discussions section. 😃[/p][p][/p][p]Happy playing! 🦐🥘[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.2.25 - Pause Functionality and Improved Dish Change Price UI
notes.content: [p]Hello Chefs![/p][p]We’re back with some updates to improve your kitchen management experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][h3][b]1. Improve Pause System[/b][/h3][p]You can now take a proper break whenever you open the pause menu. The game will fully pause, stopping all in-game movement and activities until you choose to resume. It’s a simple yet essential feature to help you take your time when needed.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/185385750c633420f3e20e86a3a0c0c31c148457.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. Clearer Dish Price Limits[/b][/h3][p]We’ve made pricing your dishes more informative. When adjusting a dish item’s price from PC or from the banner, you’ll now see a maximum price cap, preventing unrealistic pricing and helping you maintain a balanced and fair restaurant economy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/1a9a252f720b8e414aa47f33451201ef61519b3a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/99a6a4060bb428c60442d44e64b0f37786be3931.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for all the valuable feedback you've given us so far. It means a lot and helps us grow![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Coastal Kitchen Simulator Has Entered Early Access! 👨‍🍳🦞🦀🐟
notes.content: [p]Hello, Chefs! 🧑🏻‍🍳[/p][p][/p][p]The kitchen is officially open! [b]Coastal Kitchen Simulator[/b] has launched in [b]Early Access[/b], and we’re thrilled to welcome you into the chaos and charm of running your very own seaside restaurant. 🍽️🌊[/p][p]To mark this exciting milestone, we’ve rolled out a batch of updates to improve your gameplay experience, expand your kitchen’s capabilities, and polish the overall flow. Here's what’s cooking in this latest version:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Feature Updates[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]More Items in Hand[/b][/p][p]You can now carry up to [b]5 items at once[/b], giving you more flexibility in how you prep, serve, and move around the kitchen. It’s a small change that makes a big difference in speed and multitasking.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/869a84d0d95fafee9743f0d6ca3e8b413113847d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Storage Shelving[/b][/p][p]We’ve added a new [b]rack system in the Cold Storage Room[/b] that functions like the refrigerator. You can now neatly store ingredient containers on these racks for better organization and easier access.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/13f6658c36b294a8583f3a6366caaf8aac50c504.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Popularity Boost[/b][/p][p]Running a clean and efficient kitchen now rewards you even more. [b]Popularity now increases by +2%[/b], helping you grow your reputation faster and unlock more gameplay opportunities.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/45881fb20ecedb328a976594250f34217c758396.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Notes Hidden on Container[/b][/p][p]Container notes have been temporarily hidden to keep the workspace clean and avoid unnecessary visual clutter. This change helps you stay focused on what matters during peak hours.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Staff Titles[/b][/p][p]We’ve made two important naming adjustments for clarity. These titles better reflect their roles in a professional kitchen environment.[/p][list][*][p]“[b]Cook[/b]” is now called [b]Prep Cook[/b][/p][/*][*][p]“[b]Server[/b]” is now called [b]Server Assistant[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]AI Prep Cook Improvements[/b][/h3][p]Your AI kitchen helper is smarter and more efficient than ever:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ingredient Prep[/b]: Now assists with cutting ingredients (excluding crab and lobster).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Box-to-Box Scanning[/b]: If a container isn’t full, the Prep Cook will check the next available box.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resource Awareness[/b]: They’ll prioritize ingredients that are currently running low, helping you maintain better stock balance.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/e576eb8fc15b73efdb05f75cd9fbb2feff01fe1a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]AI Server Assistant Improvements[/b][/h3][p]The front-of-house support has received meaningful improvements too:[/p][list][*][p][b]Cleaning Duties[/b]: Cleans tables and washes dishes, and also [b]gains experience[/b] over time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Order Management[/b]: Takes customer orders and [b]resets their waiting time[/b] when the order is accepted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Delivery Speed Boost[/b]: Moves faster when delivering food (if enabled).[/p][/*][*][p][i](Optional fallback)[/i] If speed boost fails, the assistant [b]will skip food delivery[/b] to maintain service flow.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/053b0412bde6f9ca124f7c12a6147b7d52d9c6ed.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/ba5b92b34ad9b7ec3139fa494db68d71eb993412.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update is just the beginning of what we have planned for Early Access. We’re incredibly thankful for your support and can’t wait to continue building this culinary experience with you.[/p][p][/p][p]We always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers! 🦞🦐🐟[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630/Coastal_Kitchen_Simulator/?curator_clanid=44815846"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

We’re excited to finally welcome you into the heat of the kitchen, where you’ll cook, manage, and serve delicious seafood dishes by the sea. As we prepare for launch, here’s a look at the new features you’ll get to experience:[/p][p][/p][olist][*][p][b]New Recipes[/b][/p][p]You can now unlock and prepare [b]10 brand-new recipes[/b]. These additions bring more variety and flavor to your menu, giving you extra options to keep your customers happy and well-fed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/25291f69de9aa828de7762fad05a8215dd2d9881.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/2f99d55a7e0c4ca224d25a073a2ef81ab79737b5.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Ingredients[/b][/p][p]With [b]7 fresh ingredients[/b] introduced, your cooking possibilities just expanded. Handles front-of-house tasks by taking orders, delivering dishes, and clearing plates. They’ll help keep your workflow smooth and your customers satisfied.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cook[/b] 
Assists you in the kitchen with roasting, grilling, or boiling tasks. You can assign specific cooking roles to make food prep even more efficient.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/1d200d5299d70b7d24bcaaeba39ab00b68fdd9d1.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Storage Room Update[/b][/p][p]We’ve added a [b]snap-to-shelf feature[/b] in the Cold Storage Room to make organizing ingredient boxes easier. Your support means the world to us, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts as you dive into the Coastal Kitchen experience. 🦞🥘[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers 🧑🏻‍🍳[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630/Coastal_Kitchen_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.1.27 - Cold Storage Room, Transfer Ingredients, and More
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/c4845cae11678eaa43e19ad2f518c631f07bb3ee.jpg[/img]
Hello, Chefs! 👨🏻‍🍳

Thank you so much for playing our game and for being an incredible part of our journey. Your feedback, whether through discussion comments, in-game feedback, or other channels, has been invaluable to us. We truly appreciate your passion and insights as they help us improve and grow together.

Now, we’re excited to bring you the latest update for Coastal Kitchen Simulator. This patch will include exciting new features and challenges. Here's what's new:

[h2][b]Feature Updates[/b][/h2]
[b]1. Transfer Ingredients Between Utensils[/b]
You can now transfer multiple ingredients between utensils, like moving chopped items from your kitchen knife to an ingredient container, or between containers. This makes your food prep faster and your kitchen workflow much smoother.

[b]2. Cold Storage Room[/b]
A dedicated Cold Storage Room is now available to help you store unopened ingredient boxes more efficiently. This gives you more space and keeps your main kitchen area clutter-free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/1ff0462841a3a02418c424ab06d49bf63e543364.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/343819fd7040b715cebe31a1a0f83c318b659712.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Ingredient Spoilage System[/b]
Be careful where you leave your ingredients! Anything left outside of Refrigerators or the Cold Storage Room will spoil and be automatically discarded at the start of the next day. Proper storage is now more important than ever.

[b]4. Daily Operational Costs[/b]
Running a restaurant isn't just about cooking. Now, you’ll also need to cover daily operational expenses, including Rent, Water, and Electricity. Managing your finances wisely will be key to keeping your business afloat.

[b]5. Daily Report UI Update[/b]
The Daily Report screen has been refreshed with a cleaner layout, making it easier for you to review your performance, earnings, and progress at the end of each day.

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed box position so it now lands properly on tables when thrown.
[*] Fixed a bug where two lightboxes with the same menu would cause one to disappear after loading a save.
[*] Fixed ingredients placed outside containers disappearing after a game reload.
[/list]

Coastal Kitchen Simulator continues to grow with each development milestone, adding more depth and realism to your culinary journey. 🦞🥘

We always open to all feedback and suggestions to make this game as mature as possible. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, don’t hesitate to share your thoughts.

Thank you for being part of the community.

Cheers 🧑🏻‍🍳

notes.title: v0.1.19 - The First Update - QoL and Visuals
notes.content:
Hello everyone 🦑

We’re beyond excited to announce our upcoming game [b]Coastal Kitchen Simulator[/b], where you’ll run a cozy seaside kitchen and serve up fresh meals to hungry beachgoers! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a culinary sim enthusiast, this game offers a relaxing yet engaging experience as you manage ingredients, take orders, and build your dream coastal eatery.

As we start shaping the first playable version, we’ve been focusing on refining the core player experience—making the kitchen flow smoother and more intuitive. Here’s what’s been cooking in our latest development update:

1. [b]Improved Ingredient Box Placement[/b]
We’ve adjusted the spawn location for ingredient boxes to keep the delivery area tidy and uncluttered. This change helps improve kitchen flow and prevents unnecessary chaos when multiple deliveries arrive at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/12e10b36a61d0d774a5eaf4fde843e5f5f1aaad3.png[/img]

2. [b]Simplified Cashier Access[/b]
Cash register interactions have been optimized for quicker and easier access to change, cash, and cards. Whether you're handing over change or receiving a payment, this update makes the process feel smoother and more responsive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/e8db564b77a683e1ee04ab460081e21cca272160.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/b6b9d7224d1f184d134c686cc3ad1143bcbb2dbd.png[/img]

3. [b]Enhanced Food Visuals After Consumption[/b]
We’ve updated the visuals of items eaten by customers—now featuring a more pink, sashimi-like appearance for certain foods. This adds a touch of realism and improves the overall dining aesthetic in your seaside kitchen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/d9ffaf2fb25049fd7f1388075f7c0d995c60cbcb.png[/img]

4. [b]Double Ingredient Per Box[/b]
We’re currently testing a new system where each purchased ingredient box contains 2 items instead of just one. This ongoing update is aimed at increasing kitchen efficiency and reducing the frequency of restocking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/3666189d75010236c96ba112e71fe59562f5d53e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630898/18283cf2c60d9d9948bf5ee29add41f442f85b18.png[/img]

That wraps up our very first development update for Coastal Kitchen Simulator! 🎉 
We’re still in the early stages, but every tweak and feature we add brings us closer to delivering a cozy, satisfying kitchen management experience by the sea. 

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to let us know what you’d love to see in the game. 🦀🍽️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444630/Coastal_Kitchen_Simulator/
